General Information Only
The content on this website is provided by Commonwealth Migration Group Inc. for general informational 
purposes only. It does not constitute legal advice, immigration advice, or a substitute for a personalized 
consultation with a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant (RCIC). Immigration outcomes depend on each 
individual's specific circumstances and on the current requirements of Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship 
Canada (IRCC), Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), and other relevant authorities. 
Commonwealth Migration Group Inc. does not guarantee visa approval or any other immigration outcome.
No Client Relationship Created by Website Use
Browsing this website, using its free tools (such as calculators or eligibility checkers), or submitting a general 
inquiry does not create a professional client relationship with CMG or any RCIC. A client relationship, and the 
professional obligations that come with it, begins only once a Retainer Agreement has been signed by both 
parties.
Program Information May Change
Immigration programs, eligibility criteria, processing times, fees, and forms are set by government authorities and 
are subject to change without notice. While we aim to keep information on this site current, we cannot guarantee 
that every page reflects the most recent rules. Always verify time-sensitive details — dates, fees, scores, and 
program status — directly against the official IRCC or relevant regulator website before relying on them.
Free Tools and Calculators
Tools such as the CRS calculator, PNP eligibility checker, and NOC finder provide planning estimates only. They 
use simplified assumptions and do not replace an official eligibility assessment. Your actual score, eligibility, or 
processing outcome is determined solely by IRCC or the relevant authority at the time of application.
Regulatory Status
Commonwealth Migration Group Inc. is regulated by the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants 
(CICC). Immigration services on this website are provided by, or under the supervision of, licensed RCICs, 
including Vishal Arora (RCIC License No. R711592). You can verify any RCIC's license status on the CICC 
public register at www.college-ic.ca.
Third-Party Links and Referrals
This website may link to, or reference, third-party organizations such as government agencies, credential 
evaluation bodies, or language testing centres. We do not control and are not responsible for the content, 
accuracy, or availability of third-party websites or services.
Testimonials
Any client testimonials or reviews shown on this site reflect individual experiences and are not a guarantee of 
similar results for other clients. Each immigration matter is assessed on its own facts.

Limitation of Liability

agents are not liable for any loss or damage arising from reliance on general information published on this 
website. For the liability terms that apply to an active engagement, refer to your signed Retainer Agreement.

title: Privacy Policy
text:
Privacy Policy
Commonwealth Migration Group Inc.  ·  Ontario Corporation No. 1001703121
Last updated: [insert publish date]
Commonwealth Migration Group Inc. ("CMG," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of 
individuals who visit this website or engage our services. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information 
we collect, how we use and protect it, and the choices available to you. This policy is written to be consistent with 
Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and applicable Ontario law.
Information We Collect
Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect:
• Contact details you provide through forms on this site — name, email address, phone number, and country 
of residence;
• Information submitted through free tools (e.g., CRS calculator, eligibility checkers) — such as age, 
education, language ability, and work experience, used to generate an estimate;
• Information you provide once engaged as a client — including identity documents, immigration history, 
employment records, education credentials, family and civil status, and other supporting documentation 
required for your application;
• Website usage data collected automatically — such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited, typically 
via cookies or analytics tools; and
• Communications you send us by email, WhatsApp, phone, or through the website's chat feature.
How We Use Your Information
We use personal information to:
• Respond to inquiries and provide the free assessment or calculator results you request;
• Assess eligibility and prepare, submit, and manage immigration applications on behalf of retained clients;
• Communicate with you about your file, including with IRCC, ESDC, or other relevant authorities on a 
client's behalf;
• Meet our regulatory and legal obligations as a CICC-regulated practice; and
• Improve this website and our services.
How We Share Your Information
We do not sell personal information. We may share it only:
• With government authorities (e.g., IRCC, ESDC, CBSA) as required to process an application you have 
retained us for;
• With third-party service providers you choose to work with (e.g., certified translators, credential evaluation 
agencies, language testing centres, or medical practitioners) — only to the extent necessary and, where 
applicable, with your knowledge that you are contracting with them directly;
• With a person you have specifically authorized to communicate with us about your file, per the third-party 
authorization terms in your Retainer Agreement; and
• Where required or permitted by law, such as in response to a valid legal or regulatory request.

Electronic Communication
By using this website or engaging our services, you consent to receiving communications electronically and to the 
electronic storage of your information. We take reasonable steps to secure electronic communications and storage, 
but no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and inherent risks (such as interception, delay, or 
unauthorized access) exist.
Data Retention
For retained clients, we retain file information, including copies of documents and correspondence, for a 
minimum of six (6) years following the completion or termination of your engagement, in accordance with CICC 
regulatory requirements. Information submitted only through general website forms or free tools (without 
becoming a retained client) is retained only as long as reasonably necessary to respond to your inquiry, unless you 
ask us to delete it sooner.
Cookies and Analytics
This website may use cookies or similar technologies to remember preferences and understand how visitors use 
the site. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings; doing so may affect some site 
functionality.
Your Rights
Under PIPEDA, you have the right to:
• Access the personal information we hold about you;
• Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information;
• Withdraw consent for us to use your information, subject to legal or contractual restrictions; and
• Ask questions about how your information is handled.
To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@commonwealthmigration.ca.
Children's Information
This website is not directed at children. Where we collect information about a client's minor dependants as part of 
an immigration application, it is collected from the client (the parent or legal guardian) as part of the retained 
service, not directly from the child.
Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. 
The “Last updated” date at the top of this page indicates when it was last revised.
Contact Us and Complaints
If you have questions, concerns, or a complaint about how we handle your personal information, contact us first at 
info@commonwealthmigration.ca or +1 647 617 0750. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may also 
contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada, or — for matters concerning our conduct as a 
regulated immigration practice — the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC), 5500 North 
Service Rd., Suite 1002, Burlington, ON, L7L 6W6, Toll-Free: 1-877-836-7543, www.college-ic.ca.

title: Refund Policy
text:
Refund Policy
Commonwealth Migration Group Inc.  ·  Ontario Corporation No. 1001703121
Last updated: [insert publish date]
This Refund Policy applies to all professional services provided by Commonwealth Migration Group Inc. 
("CMG," "we," "us," or "our") and forms part of the Retainer Agreement signed by each client. Where this page 
and a signed Retainer Agreement differ, the signed Retainer Agreement governs.
All Professional Fees Are Non-Refundable
All fees paid to CMG for professional services are strictly non-refundable under any circumstances, including but 
not limited to:
• Client withdrawal, change of mind, or discontent with an application;
• Delays in processing by any governmental or third-party authority; and
• Rejection, refusal, or denial of any application by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), 
Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), or any other relevant body.
No Guarantee of Outcome
CMG and its Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants (RCICs) make no express or implied guarantees, 
warranties, or assurances regarding the outcome or success of any application or immigration process. Providing 
such guarantees is strictly prohibited under applicable laws and regulations. All professional services are 
delivered on a best-effort basis, in accordance with relevant immigration laws, professional obligations, and the 
accuracy and completeness of information and documentation provided by the client. Professional fees represent 
compensation for time, expertise, and services rendered, and are not contingent on the outcome of any 
immigration process or decision.
Exception — Discretionary Refund
If CMG is unable or unwilling to complete the services set out in a client's Retainer Agreement, and that failure is 
not due to any act or omission of the client, a partial or full refund of professional fees may be issued solely at 
CMG's discretion. Any such refund excludes government application fees and third-party disbursements, and, if 
approved, will be processed within thirty (30) days of mutual written agreement, via the original method of 
payment.
Government Fees and Disbursements
Government filing fees and third-party disbursements are separate from CMG's professional fees and are 
generally paid directly by the client to the relevant authority. Where CMG remits a government fee on a client's 
behalf, an additional 5% administrative charge applies to that fee. Refunds of government fees, where available, 
are determined solely by the relevant government authority (e.g., IRCC) and are outside CMG's control.
No Chargebacks
Clients agree not to initiate chargebacks or payment reversals through any financial institution, credit card 
company, or payment processor for fees paid to CMG. Initiating a chargeback is treated as a material breach of 
the client's Retainer Agreement, and the client remains liable for the original amount plus any related fees, 
penalties, or administrative costs.

Questions About This Policy
For questions about this policy, contact us at info@commonwealthmigration.ca or +1 647 617 0750. For the 
complete terms governing your specific engagement, refer to your signed Retainer Agreement.
